basis_limit: Policy-supported inference plus article statements where present; not an audit of confidential reviewer reports or a guarantee of historical compliance. Publisher policy does not establish scientific quality or product effectiveness.

JMIR: Regular research, review, tutorial and viewpoint articles supported by publisher policy; non-reviewed exceptional types excluded. Individual reviewer reports not audited.
BMC: Research articles and most other scholarly article types undergo review. Applied to ordinary research/review publications, not letters/editorials.
ELSEVIER: Publisher policy calls for external independent review of research articles; regular published research/review identity corroborated. Patterns reviews held out.
PLOS: Regular research publications in PLOS journals; PLOS Biology and Computational Biology editorial/review processes additionally checked. Ambiguous other types held out.
FRONTIERS: Publisher type table identifies review status of original research, reviews and methods; one included article also names a reviewer.
MDPI: Publisher process describes external review for research; included records are regular research or reviews, not editorials.
DLI: Journal describes independent review of accepted research; editorial/letter exceptions do not apply.
JAMA: Journal describes reviewed research and JAMA editorial standards.
SPRINGER: All research articles and most other article types undergo peer review. Regular original research used here; journal-specific submission guidelines additionally inspected. Do not infer the exact historical review model.
BMJ: BMJ Open external open review; included BMJ Open and JECH papers also carry article-specific external review statements.
BJP: Journal describes peer-reviewed original research/reviews. Regular published articles, not editorials.
PM: Regular original/review research uses official peer-review submission systems; historical Cambridge contributor instructions also describe referee review.
CAMPBELL: Peer-reviewed systematic reviews, evidence maps and methods; three-stage review. Older Wiley publication identities retained; current Sage policy is not proof of every historical review report.
GHP: Journal describes double-anonymized review. Applied to regular research/review, not unreviewed correspondence.
SJP: Publisher describes peer-reviewed public-health journal; regular published research identity checked.
ISP: Publisher describes peer-reviewed journal. Included original research has corroborated DOI identity.
JMR: At least two independent reviews required before acceptance/revision; double-anonymized review.
BJSP: Journal describes double-anonymous review; applied to regular research.
EJPH: Original articles and short reports receive two or more external referees.
AGING: Regular research/brief reports receive peer review. Current double-anonymized model began February 2026; not assigned retroactively to the 2022 paper.
CDC: Original Research explicitly peer reviewed; editorial policy describes single-anonymous external reviewers.
PNAS: Primary journal description identifies PNAS as peer reviewed; included record is original research with corroborated DOI/full text.
